definition: Unique case identifier: "case_" followed by five digits giving the case index, zero-padded. Cases 00000 to 00209 are the public portion.
provenance: Joins the clinical record to the case folder holding imaging.nii.gz and segmentation.nii.gz.

definition: Patient's age when they underwent nephrectomy for the renal tumor. Observed range 1 to 90.
The patient's gender.
Body mass index at the time measured nearest to the most recent imaging in the dataset. Observed range 16.2 to 49.61.
Whether the patient has myocardial infarction, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has congestive heart failure, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has peripheral vascular disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has cerebrovascular disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has dementia, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap. No case in the public portion is recorded as true.
Whether the patient has COPD, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has connective tissue disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has peptic ulcer disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has uncomplicated diabetes mellitus, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has diabetes mellitus with end organ damage, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has chronic kidney disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has hemiplegia from stroke, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has leukemia, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has malignant lymphoma, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has localized solid tumor, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has metastatic solid tumor, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has mild liver disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has moderate to severe liver disease, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap.
Whether the patient has AIDS, one entry in the comorbidities bitmap. No case in the public portion is recorded as true.
The patient's smoking history.
Age at which the patient quit smoking. Stored in the file as text (for example "43"), although the paper specifies an integer.
missingValues: "not_applicable": not applicable (134 of 210 cases)
null: not known (22 of 210 cases)

definition: Estimated cigarette pack-years smoked. Stored inconsistently: 100 cases hold the number 0 and 43 hold a number written as text (for example "30").
missingValues: null: unknown (67 of 210 cases)

definition: The patient's chewing-tobacco use. The file's values differ from the paper's list (the paper gives "never or not for more than 3mo", "quit in last 3mo", "currently chews").
The patient's alcohol use.
Whether a blood transfusion occurred during the operation, one entry in the intraoperative-complications bitmap.
Whether a injury to surrounding organ occurred during the operation, one entry in the intraoperative-complications bitmap.
Whether a cardiac event occurred during the operation, one entry in the intraoperative-complications bitmap. No case in the public portion is recorded as true.
Number of days the patient spent in hospital after the nephrectomy. Observed range 0 to 28.
missingValues: "died_before_discharge": the patient died before discharge (1 of 210 cases)

definition: Minutes the kidney was deprived of blood during the nephrectomy. Observed range 0 to 54.
missingValues: "not_applicable": radical nephrectomy (70 of 210 cases)
null: partial nephrectomy with no value available (10 of 210 cases)

definition: Tumor size reported in the radiology report. The unit is not stated by the source. Observed range 1.2 to 16.2.
Tumor size reported in the surgical pathology report. The unit is not stated by the source. Observed range 0.8 to 22.5.
Whether the postoperative surgical pathology report indicates the tumor was malignant.
T stage reported in the postoperative surgical pathology report. The paper also allows "X", "1c" and "2b"; not every allowed value occurs in the public portion.
N stage reported in the postoperative surgical pathology report.
M stage reported in the postoperative surgical pathology report.
Histologic subtype proved by surgical pathology.
Whether the surgical pathology report indicates necrotic tissue within the tumor.
missingValues: null: the report does not mention necrosis (23 of 210 cases)

definition: WHO/ISUP grade of the tumor in the postoperative surgical pathology report.
missingValues: null: ISUP grade does not apply, e.g. benign tumors or chromophobe RCC (38 of 210 cases)

definition: Grade of surgical complications on the Clavien-Dindo scale.
missingValues: null: could not be determined (1 of 210 cases)

definition: Whether the patient visited the emergency room less than 24 hours after discharge without being admitted.
missingValues: null: could not be determined (2 of 210 cases)

definition: Whether the patient was readmitted to hospital within 90 days of surgery.
missingValues: null: could not be determined, e.g. censor or death date within 90 days (2 of 210 cases)

definition: Surgeon's estimate of blood lost during the nephrectomy. Observed range 0 to 2000.
missingValues: null: not available (1 of 210 cases)

definition: Surgical technique used.
Whether the nephrectomy was partial or radical.
Surgical approach. Values are capitalized in the file, unlike the lowercase values in the paper.
Duration of the nephrectomy procedure. Observed range 44 to 613.
missingValues: null: could not be retrieved (2 of 210 cases)

definition: Whether the nephrectomy was performed for debulking (cytoreduction).
Whether the surgical pathology report indicates malignant tissue remaining at the margins of the excised tissue.
Value of the most recent eGFR measured before the nephrectomy.
missingValues: ">=90": the value was 90 or greater (33 of 210 cases)
null: no value available (57 of 210 cases)

definition: Number of days before the nephrectomy that the preoperative eGFR was measured. Observed range 1 to 90.
missingValues: null: no value available (57 of 210 cases)

definition: Value of the first eGFR measured after the nephrectomy.
missingValues: ">=90": the value was 90 or greater (20 of 210 cases)
"age<16": patient younger than 16, for whom GFR cannot be reliably estimated (2 of 210 cases)
null: no value available (53 of 210 cases)

definition: Days between the nephrectomy and this eGFR measurement. The paper defines this subfield as "days after nephrectomy", but the released file names it days_before_nephrectomy. Observed range 76 to 2,503.
missingValues: null: no value available (53 of 210 cases)

definition: Value of the most recent eGFR measured after the nephrectomy. Null when one or fewer postoperative values were available.
missingValues: ">=90": the value was 90 or greater (22 of 210 cases)
"age<16": patient younger than 16, for whom GFR cannot be reliably estimated (2 of 210 cases)
null: no value available (53 of 210 cases)

definition: Days between the nephrectomy and this eGFR measurement. The paper defines this subfield as "days after nephrectomy", but the released file names it days_before_nephrectomy. Observed range 76 to 3,070.
missingValues: null: no value available (53 of 210 cases)

definition: The patient's current vital status. Values are lowercase in the file, unlike the capitalized values in the paper.

coding.meaning: Alive at censor date (189 of 210 cases)

definition: Days from nephrectomy to the censor date or the date of death. Observed range 0 to 3,070.
Voxel spacing along the x-axis of the CT volume (pixel width), matching the affine of imaging.nii.gz. Not listed in the data paper; the README describes it. The unit is not stated.
provenance: Added to kits.json on 12 July 2021 ("finally added voxel spacing").

definition: Voxel spacing along the y-axis of the CT volume (pixel height), matching the affine of imaging.nii.gz. Not listed in the data paper; the README describes it. The unit is not stated.
provenance: Added to kits.json on 12 July 2021 ("finally added voxel spacing").

definition: Voxel spacing along the z-axis of the CT volume (slice thickness), matching the affine of imaging.nii.gz. Not listed in the data paper; the README describes it. The unit is not stated.
provenance: Added to kits.json on 12 July 2021 ("finally added voxel spacing").

definition: Voxel label in each case's segmentation volume.
provenance: Manual annotation by students under clinician supervision, as described in the data paper; label values from the README.
